subject:
POC capacity planning 
 Synthora trial next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Cho <alex.cho@synthora.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference>, dev.patel@redwood.inference
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + POC capacity ask (Synthora trial)

Hi Alex - thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the POC:

Summary of success criteria (as discussed):
- End-to-end throughput target: sustain 40 QPS for 128-token requests (completion latency target p95 < 400ms).
- Peak burst handling: tolerate short spikes up to 150 QPS for up to 2 minutes without errors.
- Output quality: top-line intent accuracy >= 92% on your validation set of 500 prompts.
- Stability: no model OOMs; KV cache warmup under 30s for typical sessions.

Immediate asks for capacity planning:
1) Confirm anticipated baseline QPS and typical sequence length distribution (you mentioned 60% short prompts, 30% medium, 10% long).
2) Confirm expected concurrency (simultaneous end-users/sessions) and whether your test harness will generate steady-state traffic vs bursty traffic.
3) Share any constraints on reserved capacity vs. need for autoscale/burst - we recommend a reserved baseline + autoscale policy to cover bursts.

Proposed Redwood plan (we'll own provisioning + monitoring during POC):
- Reserved GPUs: start with 2 x A100-80GB equivalent for baseline (estimate ~40 QPS sustained).
- Autoscale policy: allow up to 6 GPUs for bursts; scale step-by-step based on 30s average queue depth.
- Cache & batching config: enable prefix caching for typical sessions; set batching window to 8-12ms to balance latency/cost.
- Ops contacts: Marissa will be primary AM; Dylan will own trial monitoring; Dev will handle infra tuning.

Next steps: please confirm baseline QPS by end of day Monday, and attach your POC requirements sheet if you have one (we can iterate on the reserved count). Once confirmed we'll send a formal capacity plan and proposed timeline (provisioning + smoke tests + ramp).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference
[Attachment: redwood_poc_capacity_plan.pdf (proposal, 120 KB)]

From: Alex Cho <alex.cho@synthora.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@synthora.ai, dylan.brooks@redwood.inference
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + POC capacity ask (Synthora trial)

Hi Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. Confirming our baseline and a few clarifications: 

Baseline QPS: 35-45 QPS (our internal telemetry usually sits ~40 QPS during testing).
Concurrency: expected ~120 concurrent sessions during test; each session typically sends 2-3 requests in quick succession.
Sequence lengths: your distribution is correct (we see ~60% <64 tokens, ~30% 64-256, ~10% >256).
Burst profile: we will run a load test to simulate spikes up to ~160 QPS for 90-120s to validate autoscale/fallback behavior.

We attached our POC requirements sheet - it includes sample prompt sets + success criteria and a short timeline. Procurement looped in for any SOW/contract questions.

Agree with reserved + autoscale approach. One ask: during bursts we'd like a graceful degradation policy (prefer latency increase over dropped requests).

I'll plan to review your proposed capacity plan. FYI: our engineers will also want a short window (30-60 min) for a joint smoke test once provisioned.

Best,
Alex Cho
Head of ML Ops | Synthora
[Attachment: synthora_poc_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48 KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Cho <alex.cho@synthora.ai>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.inference, dev.patel@redwood.inference
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + POC capacity ask (Synthora trial)

Great - thanks for the details and the attachment, Alex. Based on your numbers we've put together a concrete capacity plan (attached) and outline below: 

Proposed capacity (POC, 2-week window):
- Reserved baseline: 2 x A100-80GB equiv (expected steady-state ~40 QPS).
- Autoscale burst: policy allows stepping to 4 GPUs at 120 QPS and up to 6 GPUs at 160+ QPS. Scale cooldown: 90s after drop below threshold.
- Routing policy: prioritize user-facing tier on reserved capacity; non-critical batch tasks route to spot/backfill pools.
- Degradation policy: when queued tokens exceed threshold we shift to longer batching windows and shed low-priority requests rather than returning errors - this preserves correctness for core flows.

Timeline:
- Tue (provision): Redwood provisions reserved capacity + base infra (2-4 hours).
- Wed (smoke tests): joint smoke test (30-60 min), validate KV cache warmup, baseline QPS.
- Thu-Fri (ramp + burst testing): run load tests up to 160 QPS; observe autoscale and graceful degradation behavior.

Ownership:
- Redwood: provisioning, autoscale tuning, on-call during test (Marissa primary, Dylan backup).
- Synthora: test harness + validation label set, procurement for any contractual items.

Please confirm you're good with 2 reserved GPUs to start and the autoscale ceiling at 6 GPUs. If you prefer starting lower we can provision 1 reserved + more aggressive autoscale, but there's a higher risk of temporary latency spikes during warm-ups.

Attached: redwood_poc_capacity_plan.pdf (detailed numbers + monitoring dashboard links).

Thanks - Marissa
[Attachment: redwood_poc_capacity_plan.pdf (proposal, 120 KB)]

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Alex Cho <alex.cho@synthora.ai>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.inference
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + POC capacity ask (Synthora trial)

Quick infra notes from my side:
- We will pre-warm model shards on reserved GPUs during provisioning to reduce first-request latency; expect warm-up < 30s for common checkpoints.
- Autoscaler knobs: we'll use queue-depth based scaling with a minimum step of 1 GPU and max step of 2 GPUs per minute to avoid flapping.
- Monitoring: we'll instrument p95/p99 latency, GPU utilization, queue depth, and OOM alerts; add a webhook to your Slack channel for alerts.
- Test credentials: Alex - can you share an SSH key for the test harness host or a short-lived token for our smoke runner?

I'll own the provisioning run. Marissa - I can start provisioning Tue morning if Alex confirms reserved count.

- Dev

From: Alex Cho <alex.cho@synthora.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, dev.patel@redwood.inference
Cc: procurement@synthora.ai
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + POC capacity ask (Synthora trial)

All good - confirm 2 reserved GPUs + autoscale up to 6. We prefer the graceful-degradation approach.

Dev: I'll share a short-lived token for the smoke runner (sending via secure channel to your infra contact).

Marissa: please go ahead with provisioning Tue morning. Procurement will follow up on the SOW template if anything else is needed.

Thanks,
Alex
